subject: [PATCH 52/60] mm: count memory with userspace placement as general purpose

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer Gregory Relay noted that the patch incorrectly uses common_free_pages() in global_dirtyable_memory(), which counts private memory as well, and suggested using nr_free_pages() instead to accurately count only free pages on common nodes.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory accounting to treat memory on nodes that can be used by userspace as general-purpose memory. This means that totalram_pages() and MemFree will count this memory, and it will also affect other metrics such as overcommit and OOM capacity. The patch introduces new functions common_free_pages() and common_file_pages() to accurately calculate the amount of free memory on these nodes. It also adjusts the calculation of global dirtyable memory to exclude private memory that serves only private bindings and migration.
